title: Free time slots in a day
description: Implement free_slots(busy, day_start, day_end). All times are 'HH:MM' 24-hour strings. busy is a list of (start, end) pairs that may be unsorted, overlapping, touching, or extend outside the working window. Return the free gaps inside [day_start, day_end] as a sorted list of (start, end) 'HH:MM' tuples. Zero-length gaps are omitted. If day_end <= day_start raise ValueError; a malformed time or a busy pair with end < start raises ValueError.
invariants: Overlapping and touching busy intervals merge.
Busy time outside the window is clipped, not an error.
Empty busy list returns the whole window as one slot.
